mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rk_ai_qa (client_ip, module, action, subject_id, subject_name, file_name, topic, question, answer, email) VALUES (#{clientIp}, #{module}, #{action}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectName}, #{fileName}, #{topic}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{email})
mapper.select: SELECT id, client_ip, module, action, subject_id, subject_name, file_name, topic, question, answer, email, created_at FROM rk_ai_qa WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

where.if: AND (client_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.ip}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.ip}, '%'))
AND ( question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR topic LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT id, client_ip, module, action, subject_id, subject_name, file_name, topic, question, answer, email, created_at FROM rk_ai_qa
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT client_ip AS ip, MAX(created_at) AS lastSeen, COUNT(*) AS count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT module ORDER BY module SEPARATOR ',') AS modules, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(subject_name ORDER BY created_at DESC), ',', 1) AS subject, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(email ORDER BY created_at DESC), ',', 1) AS email FROM rk_ai_qa
AND (client_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ip}, '%') OR email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{ip}, '%'))
GROUP BY client_ip ORDER BY lastSeen DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rk_ai_qa WHERE created_at >= CURDATE()) AS qaToday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rk_ai_qa) AS qaTotal, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip) FROM rk_ai_qa) AS ips, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_ip) FROM rk_ai_qa WHERE created_at >= CURDATE()) AS ipsToday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rk_subject WHERE enabled = 1) AS subjects
SELECT id, client_ip, module, action, subject_id, subject_name, file_name, topic, question, answer, email, created_at FROM rk_ai_qa ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
